content: Built-in three.js materials get fog uniforms + USE_FOG define automatically; raw ShaderMaterial ignores scene.fog unless fog chunks are included and material.fog=true. onBeforeCompile-patched built-ins (Lambert) keep fog support. Changing fog PRESENCE or TYPE (Fog vs FogExp2) after compile flips the USE_FOG/FOG_EXP2 defines and needs material recompile (needsUpdate); mutating fog color/near/far is uniform-only and cheap. Known issue: incorrect fog object comparison can trigger continuous material recompiles (three GH #13849).
